"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old mystery. A serial killer, known only as 'The Timekeeper,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. But this is no ordinary killer - he's a time-hopper, able to move through the ages with impunity.

As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar landscape of 1960s America, she must use her knowledge of future forensics to leave clues that will aid her modern colleagues in catching The Timekeeper. But with each passing day, she realizes that she's running out of time - literally. The Timekeeper is always one step ahead, and Rachel's only hope is to use her wits and her knowledge of the future to outsmart him.

As the body count rises, Rachel must use her skills to unravel the mystery of The Timekeeper's true identity and motivations. But with the clock ticking down, she knows that she'll have to make a choice: save the lives of her colleagues, or risk everything to prevent The Timekeeper from striking again.
